title: Pre-Market Briefing - 2026-08-25
markdown:
# Pre-Market Briefing

## 1. Market Tone
- **Confirmed:** Monday was mixed-to-soft for equities: S&P 500 -0.28%, Nasdaq -0.76%, Dow +0.26% (The Motley Fool).
- **Confirmed:** Risk appetite is still active in crypto, with Bitcoin up +1.64% Monday and above $80,000 this morning in the email’s framing (The Motley Fool).
- **Interpretation:** The tone looks rotation-heavy and event-sensitive, with AI/chip names under pressure ahead of Nvidia and broader momentum tied to macro/rates and crypto risk-on.

## 2. Macro And Calendar
- **Confirmed:** A U.S. Treasury plan to double purchases of longer-dated bonds is cited as helping push yields lower, which the email says supported risk assets like Bitcoin (The Motley Fool).
- **Confirmed:** Nvidia reports **Wednesday**; Marvell reports **Thursday** (The Motley Fool).
- **Confirmed:** Zoom, Heico, and Intuit are all reporting **after the close today** (The Motley Fool).
- **Unclear:** No full macro calendar, Fed events, or economic data releases were provided.

## 3. Earnings And Company News
- **Meta Platforms (META)**: Reportedly preparing a consumer AI agent called **Hatch** as soon as late August; a WhatsApp feature connecting users to third-party agents could arrive as soon as this week. Internal plans reportedly include a subscription tier up to **$199.99/month** (The Information, as cited by The Motley Fool).
- **Bitcoin / BTC-related risk assets**: Bitcoin topped **$80,000** this morning in the email, after a three-day surge of more than 20% and more than $4 billion in bearish liquidations. Spot Bitcoin ETFs reportedly took in **$1.92 billion** last week (The Motley Fool).
- **Semiconductors**: The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell nearly **2.9%** Monday; **MU**, **AVGO**, **AMD**, and **NVDA** were all down between **2% and 3.5%** as investors positioned for Nvidia earnings (The Motley Fool).
- **Zoom (**ZM**)**: Q2 results after the close today; last quarter revenue grew **5.5%** YoY to **$1.24B**, with 66 new $100K+ enterprise customers. Analysts expect revenue growth of **4.2%** this quarter (The Motley Fool).
- **Heico (**HEI**)**: Q3 results after the close today; last quarter EPS rose **48%** and revenue grew **25.3%**. Analysts expect **18%** revenue growth this quarter (The Motley Fool).
- **Intuit (**INTU**)**: Q4 update after the close today; last quarter revenue grew **10.5%** YoY to **$8.56B**, and guidance topped estimates. Analysts expect **11.4%** growth this quarter (The Motley Fool).
- **Cloudflare (**NET**)**: The email highlights AI-agent traffic growth, Workers platform usage, 36% revenue growth, and 120% dollar-based net retention. It also notes the stock is up more than 40% this year and around **$280** (The Motley Fool).

## 4. Top Movers And Catalysts
- **Bitcoin / related risk proxies**: Squeeze + ETF inflows + lower yields are the cited drivers; this is the cleanest momentum narrative in the email (The Motley Fool).
- **Semiconductor group (**MU**, **AVGO**, **AMD**, **NVDA**)**: Broad pre-earnings de-risking ahead of Nvidia is the main catalyst (The Motley Fool).
- **META**: Potential launch timing for **Hatch** and WhatsApp agent features could matter if the market views it as a monetizable AI distribution layer (The Motley Fool / The Information).
- **Cloudflare (**NET**)**: AI-agent traffic and strong usage metrics reinforce the theme, but no fresh trading catalyst is given in the email (The Motley Fool).
- **Earnings names today:** **ZM**, **HEI**, **INTU** all have after-close reports; could move sharply but the note is more descriptive than actionable (The Motley Fool).

## 5. Ranked Buy Candidates
> No idea here is strong enough to treat as a high-conviction pre-open buy. These are the best-formed setups from the email, ranked by relative trade quality.

### 1) **META** — Catalyst Continuation
- **Catalyst:** Reported launch of consumer AI agent **Hatch** late August, possible WhatsApp third-party agent feature this week, and a high-end subscription plan up to **$199.99/month** (The Motley Fool / The Information).
- **Why it might matter for a swing trade:** If the market believes Meta is monetizing AI through distribution and workflow integration, it can support multiple expansion and keep AI optimism alive.
- **What would invalidate it:** If launch timing slips, feature details disappoint, or the market views the subscription price as unrealistic/immaterial.
- **Must check before entry:** Price reaction at the open, whether the stock is holding key intraday support, and whether the news is confirmed by Meta rather than only reported.

### 2) **NET** — Trend Pullback
- **Catalyst:** Ongoing AI-agent traffic expansion, 36% revenue growth, and 120% dollar-based net retention (The Motley Fool).
- **Why it might matter for a swing trade:** This is a durable theme stock with recurring demand; pullbacks can attract buyers if the AI infrastructure theme stays in favor.
- **What would invalidate it:** Loss of momentum in the broader software/infrastructure group or evidence the market is rotating out of high-multiple growth.
- **Must check before entry:** Whether shares are actually pulling back into support versus breaking down, and whether there is any fresh catalyst beyond the theme article.
- **Pass if:** No clean entry, or if the stock is extended and the email provides no new catalyst.

### 3) **BTC / Bitcoin-linked exposure** — Breakout / Momentum
- **Catalyst:** Bitcoin above **$80,000**, short squeeze, $4B+ in bearish liquidations, and strong ETF inflows of **$1.92B** last week (The Motley Fool).
- **Why it might matter for a swing trade:** Momentum plus institutional inflows can sustain follow-through if price accepts above the prior breakout area.
- **What would invalidate it:** ETF inflows slow, the move fails back under breakout levels, or the rally proves to be just short covering.
- **Must check before entry:** Whether BTC is holding above the breakout, whether ETF inflow data continues, and whether the move is broad-based across related names.

## 6. Swing Setup Board
| Ticker | Type | Setup | Trigger | Stop / Invalidation | First Target Logic | Sizing Caution | Pass If |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **META** | Catalyst Continuation | AI agent rollout / monetization | Positive confirmation of Hatch / WhatsApp agent news and price holding early strength | News fails to confirm, or stock loses opening support | Prior swing high / next resistance zone | Keep size modest until launch details are confirmed | If the move is only rumor-driven and fades quickly |
| **NET** | Trend Pullback | AI infrastructure leader | Pullback holds and buyers defend support | Breaks support or AI/software group weakens | Reclaim of recent highs / continuation of trend | Avoid chasing after a sharp gap or extended run | If there is no pullback or no fresh catalyst |
| **BTC / crypto proxies** | Breakout / Momentum | Risk-on squeeze continuation | Hold above the breakout area after $80K move | Reclaims fail and price slips back into prior range | Measured move / next round-number resistance | Crypto can whipsaw; use reduced size | If ETF inflows stall or price immediately reverses |
| **NVDA / semis** | Risk Watch | Pre-earnings event risk | Only consider after earnings reaction, not pre-event | Broad sector selloff extends or earnings bar remains too high | Reaction trade only if guidance clears the bar | Avoid pre-earnings “hope” entries | If holding through earnings without a plan |
| **ZM / HEI / INTU** | Risk Watch | After-close earnings lottery | Wait for report and post-earnings price action | Misses, weak guidance, or gap failure | Only if price/action confirms post-report | Earnings gap risk is high | If you need direction before the print |

## 7. Setup Watch
- **META**: Most interesting pre-open if the AI agent news is confirmed and the stock shows acceptance above opening levels.
- **NET**: Worth watching only as a leadership stock in the AI/infra theme; the email does not provide a fresh catalyst.
- **Bitcoin / crypto-linked names**: Best momentum theme in the note; watch whether the move holds after the open and whether ETF flow narrative persists.
- **NVDA / semis**: Watch for pre-earnings pressure and whether the weakness spreads or stabilizes.
- **ZM / HEI / INTU**: Pure event risk into the close; better as post-earnings reaction candidates than pre-open buys.

## 8. Risk Watch
- **NVDA**: Market is already pricing in strong growth; even good results may disappoint if the bar is too high (The Motley Fool).
- **Semiconductor group**: Broad weakness before earnings can continue if investors keep de-risking AI spend exposure.
- **Bitcoin**: The email itself warns that one strong week does not prove a durable trend; short-covering can fade (The Motley Fool).
- **META**: News is currently based on reporting, not a confirmed product launch announcement.
- **After-close earnings names**: **ZM**, **HEI**, and **INTU** can all gap sharply; avoid assuming direction before the print.

## 9. Sector And Theme Watch
- **AI / semis**: Pre-earnings caution is pressuring **MU**, **AVGO**, **AMD**, **NVDA**; the market is treating Nvidia as a read-through for the broader AI buildout (The Motley Fool).
- **AI agents / platform monetization**: **META** and **NET** are both framed around agents, workflows, and distribution, though with very different business models.
- **Crypto / risk assets**: Bitcoin is acting as the clearest risk-on indicator in the email.
- **Enterprise software**: **ZM** and **INTU** are highlighted as slower-growth reports versus easier comps, suggesting more scrutiny on growth rates.
- **Aerospace / defense software-adjacent industrials**: **HEI** is expected to decelerate versus its prior quarter.

## 10. Worth Reading
- The note on **META** and the possible **Hatch** AI agent rollout.
- The Bitcoin section on short squeeze mechanics plus ETF inflows.
- The Nvidia setup piece explaining why the whole chip group is trading as one event.
- The **Cloudflare** article excerpt for the longer-term AI-agent infrastructure theme.

## 11. Open Questions
- Is Meta’s AI agent timing confirmed by Meta, or only reported by The Information?
- Will Bitcoin ETF inflows continue next week, or was last week mostly squeeze-driven?
- Can **NVDA** clear an already high expectations bar on Wednesday?
- Will the semis stabilize pre-earnings or keep fading?
- Do **ZM**, **HEI**, and **INTU** show enough post-close reaction to create tradable follow-through?

## Notable Noise
- The **Cloudflare** section is constructive but not tied to a fresh tradable catalyst in the email.
- The “Your Take” reader comment is not actionable for trading.
- No broader economic calendar was provided, so macro timing remains incomplete.
